title: PIXL 8000 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pink Lemonade from PIXL 8000 blends citrus tang with soft red fruit for a fizzy, refreshing vape. This flavour captures the nostalgic sparkle of classic pink lemonade in vapour form. The pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is paired with a 10ml refill reservoir. Used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, it delivers up to 8000 puffs with smooth flavour from the mesh coil inside. A go-to option for MTL vaping with a bright, bubbly twist. Boost Mode adds an extra punch when you need it. Pink Lemonade is a favourite for vapers who enjoy a sweet citrus vape.
